section: Claude role as a swarm context graph worker

rows.quote: A swarm context graph worker is a Claude role that runs `rf` through its shell tool and follows the swarm recipe of the installed rf skill.

pins.title: SCG-R15 R1: the page's block declares exactly one Claude role, whose tools carry Bash and whose prompt names the installed rf skill and SWARM_RF_WORKSPACE
suite: wb-973.15 SCG-R15: the docs/19 swarm context graph worker role

rows.quote: `rf install-skill --agent claude` writes that skill to `~/.claude/skills/rf/`, whose `references/swarm-integration.md` holds the recipe.
rows.reason: RFCLI's own install fact, not Pi's: measured with rf install-skill --list --json on rf 0.1.845 (2026-10-26: the claude destination is ~/.claude/skills/rf and the skill's files include references/swarm-integration.md); the default gate runs no rf, so no default-gate case can vouch for it

rows.quote: This page names that location and never restates the recipe, and the repository tracks no copy of the skill.

pins.title: SCG-R15 R3a: the section names the installed skill's location and restates no recipe step: no rendered rf command beyond rf install-skill
suite: wb-973.15 SCG-R15: the docs/19 swarm context graph worker role

pins.title: SCG-R15 R3b: the repository tracks no copy of the rf skill: no rf directory under a skills directory, no recipe file and no SKILL.md naming rf
